description: The bar chart displays the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories on the horizontal axis labeled "Simple," "Moderate," "Challenging," and "Total," with the vertical axis representing "Execution Accuracy" on a linear scale ranging from 20 to 60 in increments of 10. Each category contains two adjacent bars: a light blue bar representing NatSQL and a darker blue bar representing TA-SQL, as indicated by the legend. For the "Simple" category, NatSQL achieves an accuracy of 60.21 while TA-SQL achieves 63.14. In the "Moderate" category, NatSQL scores 39.64 and TA-SQL scores 48.60. For the "Challenging" category, NatSQL scores 32.32 and TA-SQL scores 36.11. The "Total" category shows NatSQL with a total accuracy of 51.35 and TA-SQL with 56.19. The bars are presented in the order of increasing complexity from left to right, with no visual emphasis or sorting beyond the categorical order.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across three task complexity levels: Simple, Moderate, and Challenging, as well as a Total category. The horizontal axis categorizes the task complexity, labeled as Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents execution accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60 in 10-unit intervals. TA-SQL consistently outperforms NatSQL across all categories, with the largest margin observed in the Moderate category, where TA-SQL achieves approximately 52.60 compared to NatSQL's 39.64. In the Challenging category, TA-SQL shows a slight decline to 34.11, while NatSQL remains stable at 32.32. Overall, TA-SQL demonstrates a steady increase in accuracy across complexity levels, culminating in a total accuracy of 58.19, which is significantly higher than NatSQL's 51.35.
